test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: The term “OncoMark” was recently in the news. What does it refer to?

options.text: A national registry for tracking cancer patients
An AI-based framework for predicting cancer cell behaviour
A new cancer drug for cancer-tumour suppression
A gene-editing tool for removing cancerous mutations

solution:
The correct answer is __**An AI-based framework for predicting cancer cell behaviour.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Researchers have developed an AI-based framework named 'OncoMark' to examine the internal processes that cancer cells use to grow, helping predict their future behaviour.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **OncoMark analyses cellular mechanisms involved in cancer growth.**
 
• **It enables prediction of tumour behaviour using AI-driven biological insights.**
 
• **The study was published in the journal *Communications Biology* in October.**
 
• **Developed jointly by Ashoka University, Sonipat and S N Bose National Centre for Basic Sciences, Kolkata.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **AI-based Cancer Prediction Tools**__

 __
 
• Use machine learning to analyse biological pathways, gene expression, and tumour behaviour.
 
• Support personalised treatment planning by predicting response patterns.
 
 
 
• **Hallmarks of Cancer**__
 __
 
• Biological traits that enable cancerous growth, such as resisting cell death or sustaining proliferative signalling.
 
• Typically under-measured in traditional diagnostic approaches.
 
 
 
• **Communications Biology**__
 __
 
• A peer-reviewed scientific journal publishing research in life sciences.
 
 
 
• **Ashoka University & S N Bose National Centre**__
 
 
• Collaborated on the OncoMark project focusing on computational cancer biology.
 
• Work contributes to precision oncology and advanced diagnostic development.
